rules.description: HHKB: tap left_control -> toggle Vim Mode (hold = Control)
(Vim 1/11) caps_lock -> on, caps_lock, esc, control+[ or any pointing_button -> off
(Vim 2/11) finger on trackpad + any key -> off
Layer 2: left_option+h/j/k/l/u/i/y/o -> arrows, word jumps, line start/end (shift selects)
Layer 2: left_option+; -> fn+f1 (temp desktop view), left_option+' -> caps_lock
Layer 2: left_option+]/s -> Claude notification jump / dismiss
